title: The Kallas warehouse
note: A small end-to-end test mission. Calibration values (CPU costs, HP) are slice settings, not claimed source rules; the alert clock is the SRD's two-failures-per-Alert rule; procedures follow the CWN sequence.
objective: Recover the shipping manifest that proves the shipment was re-routed.

approaches.investigative: Persuade the night clerk that the discrepancy is in his employer's interest, and he fetches the manifest.
approaches.tactical: A guard blocks the loading bay; the manifest is on the terminal behind him.
approaches.mixed: Talk past the clerk, then take the terminal under the guard's nose.

encounter.note: Optional. The mission is completable without fighting.
